// diagnostic

E0376

C-style counter loop headers are retired.

What

C-style counter loop headers are retired.

Why

A three-slot loop header is binding, source, and step rule — not init, condition, and assignment (D-LOOP-HEADER3=D).

Fix

Write `loop i in 0..<n { … }` or `loop i in 0..n, 2 { … }`; keep `loop name := value, condition { … }` for mutable state.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0376: tests/ui/loop_counter_form_retired.stderr.
